_instructions.readMeFirst: This whole website is powered by THIS file. You do not need to touch any .html, .css or .js file to manage content. Just edit the arrays below and save.
_instructions.howToAddAnAnime: Copy an existing object inside the 'anime' array whose category is 'anime'. Give it a unique 'id' (lowercase, no spaces, use dashes, e.g. 'my-new-show'). Fill in title, genres, releaseYear, studio, rating, description. Add at least one season with at least one episode.
_instructions.howToAddAMovie: Copy an existing object whose category is 'movie'. Movies do not use 'seasons' - they use a single top-level 'watchLink' and a 'duration' field instead (e.g. '1h 45m').
_instructions.howToAddAGenre: Add the new genre name as a string to the top-level 'genres' list, then add that same exact spelling to the 'genres' array of any anime/movie that belongs to it. Genre pages are generated automatically from this list - you never need to create a new genre page file.
_instructions.howToAddASeason: Inside an anime object, add a new object to its 'seasons' array with the next 'seasonNumber' and an 'episodes' array.
_instructions.howToAddAnEpisode: Inside a season, add a new object to 'episodes' with 'episodeNumber', 'title', 'thumbnail', 'duration', 'description' and 'watchLink'.
_instructions.howToEditPosters: Change the 'poster' field to the path of any image inside the /images/posters/ folder. Recommended size: 400x600px (2:3 ratio).
_instructions.howToEditBanners: Change the 'banner' field to the path of any image inside /images/banners/. Recommended size: 1600x640px (wide).
_instructions.howToEditThumbnails: Episode and screenshot thumbnails live in /images/thumbnails/. Recommended size: 480x270px (16:9).
_instructions.howToEditWatchLinks: IMPORTANT: 'watchLink' is just a generic outbound URL field (for example a Telegram post, a creator's own hosting page, or any link you are legally authorised to share). The site does NOT include or bundle any copyrighted video files - you are responsible for only ever linking to content you own or have the rights to distribute. Leave watchLink as an empty string ("") to show a 'Link coming soon' state instead of a dead link.
_instructions.howToEditSocialLinks: Edit the 'socialLinks' object below - every icon in the footer reads directly from these URLs, nothing is hardcoded in the HTML.
_instructions.ratingScale: rating is out of 10, one decimal place, e.g. 8.7
_instructions.imagesNote: All sample artwork in /images is procedurally generated placeholder art (gradients + text), not real studio posters, so the demo never ships with copyrighted artwork. Swap in your own licensed images before going live.
_instructions.howToEditGenreMeta: Each entry in 'genreMeta' controls a genre's tagline, icon and theme colors shown on genre tiles and used as a fallback theme on anime-details pages. Key must match a genre name exactly.
_instructions.howToEditAnimeTheme: Add an optional 'theme' object {name, themePrimary, themeSecondary, themeAccent} to any anime/movie to give its details page a unique color scheme. If omitted, the page falls back to its first genre's theme in genreMeta.
_instructions.howToEditNextEpisode: Add an optional 'nextEpisode' object {episodeLabel, airDateISO} to any Ongoing anime to show a live countdown on its details page. Use an ISO 8601 UTC date ending in 'Z'. Remove the field once you no longer want a countdown shown.
_instructions.howToEditNews: Edit the top-level 'news' array to control the homepage Anime News section. Each article needs id, title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), image, summary and an optional relatedAnimeId linking to a title in the catalog.
_instructions.howToEditWatchLinksDemo: Every episode/movie 'watchLink' currently points to demo-link.html (a built-in placeholder page) so the Watch buttons work out of the box. Replace these with your own licensed watch URLs whenever you're ready - see howToEditWatchLinks above for the rules on what you may link to.
